sceneTemplates.name: UGC รีวิว
sceneTemplates.desc: คนถือสินค้า รีวิวจริง
sceneTemplates.imageScene: UGC-style realistic photo, natural lighting. The reviewer presents the product with explosive energy like a top TikTok live-commerce host — proud, wide-eyed, big excited smile or amazed open mouth. The setting matches the product's real usage context.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The reviewer speaks directly to camera with high energy while holding and presenting the product, leaning slightly forward with genuine excitement, making direct eye contact, natural handheld home-video feel.

sceneTemplates.name: ไลฟ์สด
sceneTemplates.desc: ขายไลฟ์ ringlight
sceneTemplates.imageScene: UGC-style realistic photo inside a home live-selling studio: glowing ring light, stacks of products on the table beside, warm indoor lighting, phone-facing POV. The reviewer sits or stands behind the table presenting the product straight to camera like mid-livestream.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The reviewer talks to camera like in the middle of a livestream — picks the product up from the table, brings it close to the lens then back, ring-light catchlight in the eyes, energetic selling rhythm.

sceneTemplates.name: มือ POV
sceneTemplates.desc: รีวิว ไม่เห็นหน้า
sceneTemplates.imageScene: First-person POV shot, only hands visible — no face, no body. The hands hold and present the product close to camera showing its real texture and details, natural daylight, casual authentic phone-shot review feel.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: POV hands demonstrate the product — turning it, opening it, pointing at key details — while an unseen narrator speaks. The speaker is never visible; voice-over only.

sceneTemplates.name: สาธิตใช้จริง
sceneTemplates.desc: โชว์การใช้งาน
sceneTemplates.imageScene: UGC-style realistic photo of a mid-action demonstration: the reviewer is actually using the product the way it is meant to be used, medium shot, a frozen action moment in an authentic environment.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The reviewer demonstrates using the product step by step while talking to camera — glancing at the product then back to the lens, finishing with a satisfied confident nod.

sceneTemplates.name: ก่อน-หลัง
sceneTemplates.desc: เทียบผลลัพธ์
sceneTemplates.imageScene: UGC-style realistic photo showing the visible result after using the product: the reviewer points proudly at the result area, expression implying a clear before/after difference, product held in the other hand.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The reviewer points at the visible result, gestures comparing before and after with both hands, reacts amazed, then holds the product up to camera as the reason.

sceneTemplates.name: ความรู้สึก
sceneTemplates.desc: รีแอคหลังใช้ ประทับใจ
sceneTemplates.imageScene: UGC-style realistic close-up on the reviewer's face right after using the product — genuine delighted reaction, touched satisfied expression, the product held up near the face.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: Close-up reaction shot: the reviewer expresses honest delight about the result, subtle disbelieving head shakes, warm genuine smile while speaking to camera.

sceneTemplates.name: ซูมสินค้า
sceneTemplates.desc: โชว์รายละเอียดใกล้ๆ
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Extreme close-up macro shot of the product held in hands — texture, label and fine details razor sharp, shallow depth of field, background fully blurred, natural light.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: Camera stays tight on the product while hands slowly rotate it, revealing every angle and detail; an unseen narrator describes what we see. Voice-over only, speaker not visible.

sceneTemplates.name: แนะนำ
sceneTemplates.desc: พูดแนะนำให้เพื่อน
sceneTemplates.imageScene: UGC-style realistic photo: the reviewer gives a confident thumbs-up while holding the product, big assured smile, recommending it like telling a best friend, friendly medium shot.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The reviewer recommends the product straight to camera like talking to a close friend — nodding confidently, thumbs-up gesture, pointing at the product on the final beat.

sceneTemplates.name: โกดัง
sceneTemplates.desc: ส่งตรงจากคลัง
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Inside a real distribution warehouse: tall metal shelving stacked with many identical units of the product, the reviewer stands beside the shelves holding one unit up. No price tags, no closed parcel boxes hiding the product.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The reviewer presents the product among the warehouse shelves, gesturing back at the huge stock behind them, energetic "shipped straight from the warehouse" vibe.

sceneTemplates.name: โรงงาน
sceneTemplates.desc: ข้างสายพานผลิต
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Inside a clean modern factory: a conveyor line with the product moving along it, two or three blurred uniformed workers in the background, the reviewer in the foreground holding the product. No recognizable brand logos on any machinery.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The reviewer presents the product beside the running conveyor line, pointing back at the production behind, confident "direct from the factory" energy.

sceneTemplates.name: ห้างฯ
sceneTemplates.desc: ช้อปปิ้งในห้างหรู
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Inside a bright premium shopping mall retail store: clean stocked shelves, bright LED retail lighting, the reviewer holds the product in the aisle with a delighted expression. No store logos visible.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The reviewer presents the product in the retail aisle — picks it from the shelf, shows it to camera with delight, premium shopping atmosphere around.

sceneTemplates.name: ตลาดสด
sceneTemplates.desc: แผงตลาดไทย
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Thai fresh-market stall scene: wooden stalls, wicker baskets, natural daylight filtering through canvas roofs, lively local vibe. The reviewer holds the product up by the stall.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The reviewer presents the product at the market stall with friendly street energy, gesturing at the lively market around them.

sceneTemplates.name: โฆษณาสตูดิโอ
sceneTemplates.desc: มืออาชีพ สวยงาม
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Polished commercial studio advertisement: seamless backdrop, dramatic professional studio lighting, 8K commercial quality. The product is hero-lit at center of attention; the presenter is styled professionally.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: Premium commercial pacing: the presenter delivers polished ad lines to camera while the product gets slow cinematic hero moves and elegant light sweeps.

sceneTemplates.name: สินค้าอย่างเดียว
sceneTemplates.desc: ไม่มีคน
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Product-only hero shot — no people anywhere. The product displayed on a styled surface matching its category, dramatic commercial lighting, tasteful prop accents, crisp clean composition.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: No people on screen: slow orbit and push-in moves on the product with elegant light sweeps; an unseen narrator sells the product. Voice-over only.

sceneTemplates.name: Lifestyle
sceneTemplates.desc: ใช้งานจริง สถานการณ์จริง
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Candid lifestyle scene: the product being used naturally in a real daily-life situation, warm natural light, documentary feel, the reviewer blending into the authentic environment.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: A natural day-in-the-life moment featuring the product in real use; the reviewer talks casually while living the scene, nothing staged.

sceneTemplates.name: Social Viral
sceneTemplates.desc: สะดุดตา เหมาะ TikTok/IG
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Bold eye-catching composition built to stop the scroll: punchy saturated colors, dynamic angle, exaggerated fun energy, TikTok/IG-native look with the product impossible to miss.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: Fast attention-grabbing opening, dynamic in-your-face presentation of the product, punchy movements timed to the speech beats.

sceneTemplates.name: 3D คน
sceneTemplates.desc: การ์ตูนคนน่ารัก
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Pixar-style 3D animated cartoon, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting: a cute 3D cartoon Thai person with an exaggerated troubled expression facing the everyday problem this product solves. The real product appears prominently and must stay photorealistic exactly as the reference.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The cute 3D cartoon person acts out the problem, then lights up with joy as the product saves the day — bouncy cartoon motion, expressive face. The real product stays photorealistic exactly as the reference.

sceneTemplates.name: 3D สัตว์
sceneTemplates.desc: สัตว์น่ารัก
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Pixar-style 3D animated cartoon, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting: an adorable 3D cartoon animal looking sad or troubled by the problem this product solves. The real product appears prominently and must stay photorealistic exactly as the reference.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The adorable 3D cartoon animal struggles with the problem, then bounces with happiness as the product fixes everything — playful cartoon motion. The real product stays photorealistic exactly as the reference.

sceneTemplates.name: 3D ผลไม้
sceneTemplates.desc: ผัก/ผลไม้
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Pixar-style 3D animated cartoon, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting: a cute 3D cartoon fruit or vegetable character looking wilted and dull from the problem this product solves. The real product appears prominently and must stay photorealistic exactly as the reference.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The cartoon fruit/vegetable character droops with the problem, then plumps up fresh and glowing thanks to the product — squashy bouncy cartoon motion. The real product stays photorealistic exactly as the reference.

sceneTemplates.name: 3D สิ่งของ
sceneTemplates.desc: สิ่งของน่ารัก
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Pixar-style 3D animated cartoon, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting: a cute 3D cartoon everyday object character looking old, dirty or broken from the problem this product solves. The real product appears prominently and must stay photorealistic exactly as the reference.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The cartoon object character suffers the problem, then gets revived sparkling-new thanks to the product — charming cartoon motion. The real product stays photorealistic exactly as the reference.

sceneTemplates.name: 3D รถ
sceneTemplates.desc: รถแบบ Cars
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Pixar Cars-style 3D animated cartoon, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting: a cute 3D cartoon car with expressive eyes looking dusty, tired or troubled by the problem this product solves. The real product appears prominently and must stay photorealistic exactly as the reference.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The cartoon car struggles (dusty, sluggish), then revs up shiny and happy thanks to the product — fun automotive cartoon motion. The real product stays photorealistic exactly as the reference.

sceneTemplates.name: 3D อวัยวะ
sceneTemplates.desc: เกี่ยวกับสินค้า
sceneTemplates.imageScene: Pixar-style 3D animated cartoon, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting: a cute 3D cartoon body-organ character (matching the product's benefit) looking weak or uncomfortable. The real product appears prominently and must stay photorealistic exactly as the reference.
sceneTemplates.videoScene: The cute organ character feels weak, then glows healthy and energetic thanks to the product — gentle uplifting cartoon motion. The real product stays photorealistic exactly as the reference.

angleRules.mistake: มุมขาย: เปิดด้วยปัญหา/ความผิดพลาดที่คนมักเจอเมื่อไม่ใช้ของแบบนี้ แล้วพลิกมาเสนอสินค้าเป็นทางออก

locks.product: IMPORTANT: Do NOT modify, change, or alter the product in any way. The product must retain all its original details, design, colors, labels, and packaging exactly as shown in the reference image.
locks.price: STRICT TEXT RULE: Render ONLY the exact headline text provided above — nothing else. Do NOT add, invent, or overlay any price numbers, currency symbols, discount percentages, or promotional price badges. Never render the literal labels "H1" or "H2" — render only the actual Thai headline content.
locks.noTextStrict: DO NOT ADD ANY TEXT, LETTERS, WORDS, OR TYPOGRAPHY TO THE IMAGE. The image must be completely clean with no text at all — no captions, no titles, no labels, no watermarks. Absolutely zero text.
locks.faceLock: The person in the reviewer reference image is the reviewer of this clip: keep their face, hairstyle and overall look consistent with that reference. Do not depict any real or famous individual.
locks.noKids: Adults only — no children, no babies anywhere in the frame.
locks.thaiOnly: All dialogues must be in Thai language only.
locks.videoNegative: No English speech, no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text overlays, no watermarks, no logos, no morphing or distorted text, no background music, no sound effects — clear Thai speech only.
